experiment: CBF-1 oracle factorization and criterion swap audit
basis: Four normalized numeric attributes in the family's catalog order, followed by constant 1, padded with zeros to width 32. Criterion is signed one-hot at its attribute slot, with constant coordinate 1 for minimizing criteria, otherwise 0.
basis_scope: Valid only for this benchmark's same-family candidate sets. No thresholds, distance-reference criteria, or categorical labels are generated. Does not establish general-task linear representability.
hybrid_targets: Candidate map receives all four numeric attributes plus constant on existing train candidates. Criterion map receives the exact signed one-hot plus constant on existing train queries. This privileged supervision is diagnostic only; full CBF-32 is reloaded, not refit.

hybrid_training.architecture: one bias-free linear map from frozen 384-wide text embeddings to width 32 per hybrid; only first five coordinates participate
hybrid_training.loss: mean squared vector error on the five active coordinates
hybrid_training.sampling: same flattened train candidate/query pairs as CBF-0; equal example weights; no new rows, no held-out labels in fitting

gate0: Every source row: top-1 and pairwise agreement 1, maximum oracle score absolute error <= 1e-12.
hybrid_adequacy: Top-1 and pairwise >= 0.95 on BOTH genuinely unseen splits and EACH wholly held-out family. Report baseline-paired criterion-group CI too; a relative gain alone does not establish adequate attributes.
support_diagnostic: Training criteria use only slots 0/1. Slots 2/3 are absent from training criterion directions, although all candidate attributes are supervised in the candidate probe. Report criterion target span rank, unsupported target residuals, and held-family metrics for supported versus unsupported directions. Unsupported-coordinate failure is not evidence that an encoder lacks semantic information.
decision_tree: Oracle fail: oracle factorization/hypothesis not validated. Oracle pass + candidate hybrid fail: tested fixed-budget candidate map is inadequate; do not claim information absent from frozen embeddings. Candidate hybrid pass + criterion hybrid fail: criterion mapping limitation, qualified by unsupported-direction identifiability. Both hybrids pass + full CBF fail: consistent with joint alignment/optimization failure, not proof of a unique cause. Both hybrids fail: both tested mappings inadequate, not a uniquely identified criterion bottleneck.

swaps.pairing: For each fixed evaluation scenario, all ordered pairs of rows with distinct semantic criterion IDs; retain all wording combinations. Same-criterion wording swaps excluded. Teacher-stable pairs retained as controls; no fitting on swaps.
swaps.CRA: Mean(student winner changed == teacher winner changed), all criterion swaps.
primary_conditional_metrics: student change rate given teacher change
student changed AND arrived at the new teacher winner given teacher change
both old and new student winners correct given teacher change
swaps.stable_control: Student change rate conditional on teacher winner staying the same
swaps.weighting: Equal ordered row-pair weights; report split/family/K bins and explicit denominators. Conditional rates null when denominator is zero. Also retain criterion-blind32/64 interventions from CBF-0.
